settings.ahrefs_project_note: Ahrefs Rank Tracker project 'Equinet Academy Courses'. Supplies real SERP positions, search volume and keyword difficulty alongside Search Console's impressions/clicks/average position.

live_rank.note: URL of the live-rank Worker (see serverless/README.md). Empty = the Live Google Rank column stays inactive. The dashboard only requests live ranks for rows currently on screen; the Worker caches and enforces a daily budget cap.

settings.country_note: ISO-3166-1 alpha-3, lowercase, as required by the GSC API. Set to null to track worldwide positions.
settings.window_note: Each weekly snapshot covers the 7-day window ending 3 days before the Monday run, because Search Console data needs ~2-3 days to finalise.

keyword_type_rules.primary: Bottom-funnel or course-intent keyword that names the course offering (e.g. 'seo course singapore').
keyword_type_rules.secondary: Bottom-funnel commercial keyword without explicit course wording.
keyword_type_rules.supporting: Top-funnel / informational keyword that supports the course topic.
keyword_type_rules.discovered: Assigned automatically by the collector to real GSC queries not present in this config.
